description:
What is MTF? What is margin in MTF and is it available for delivery trading as well? In this video I have discussed Margin Trading Facility which is an arrangement where one can work out a trade by paying a portion of the entire required amount. The rest amount is available as a loan to the investor from the broker's end. For intraday MTF trading the interest is not applicable. For delivery MTF trading charges are levied in the form of interest. I have also discussed about pleding and unpleding in brief in this video. Check this video for more information and let us know in comments if you have doubts.

Open Dhan Account: https://tapthe.link/dhanfreeac
